I added a `/partners` gate to [i:/Scratch/_trimtest/T4-A-1/proxy.ts](proxy.ts). I haven't run, built or type-checked it, and nothing is committed.

- **What it does:** `/partners` and everything under it redirects to `/client/login` unless the request carries a valid `sol_client` session cookie. It uses the same `verifyClientSessionEdge` check and the same path-normalisation as the `/client` gate.
- **There is no `/partners` page yet.** The gate is in place but has nothing to protect until you add one.
- **Any client can open it.** The `/client` gate has no single password: each client has its own hash in `content/clients/<slug>/config.ts`. So I gated on "any valid client session", which means every logged-in client could open `/partners`. If you want it limited to specific clients or to the owner, say which. The owner option would reuse the `/lab` check (`ADMIN_COOKIE`).
- **Login lands on the portal.** After signing in, the user ends up at the portal rather than back on `/partners`, because the `/client` gate has no return-URL handling either.
